headline: Purge bug fixed mid-factory; the mini gets its second QA slot
lede: A worktree-purge rule shipped an hour ago could delete live builder worktrees — it ate this shift's first workspace. Fixed, gated by a mutant that replays the exact loss, and shipped. Then: the Mac mini now runs two QA lanes at once, visible on the board like any other slot.

notes.text: #2293 (PR #2295, live): worktreepurge judged any clean worktree at origin/main landed — including fresh ones a lane had just opened. The ancestry rule now needs a DETACHED head; 39/0 gates incl. a layer-D mutant that reproduces the deletion to prove the fix is load-bearing.

#2280 (PR #2297): mini runs 2 QA slots — node mini2 with its own identity, dev port 5179, tap :8014, launchd job, board cell qa·mini·2, watch pane + live pane, planner reserves (queue and flagship both one step behind mini), shared inference as agreed.
The board's SLOTS line is null-safe against old telemetry by design: qa·mini·2 shows idle until the new pulse field lands — verified in Chrome against both the live board.json and an injected one.
Lanes: keep the first commit early — a clean worktree at origin/main was one warden tick from deletion all day until cf146a8 shipped.
